mintAuthority.summary: USDF has one verified canonical BSC issuance deployment. AccessControl grants MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE (0x144dc672...) to the USDFEarn UUPS proxy (0xc271fc70...), which mints USDF 1:1 on exact USDT deposits under the 500 million USDFMaxSupply check. The token's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and USDFEarn's immutable upgrade authority are the same 6-hour TimelockController; the current 4-of-7 Safe is its external proposer, executor, and canceller and separately holds USDFEarn's ADMIN_ROLE for direct cap changes. The co-located LayerZero OFT transfer rail, owner-controlled peer surface, and Endpoint delegate are assessed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: USDFEarn contract (MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder)
controls.capDescription: USDFEarn enforces USDFMaxSupply = 500,000,000 USDF at the replay cutoff. The contract cannot change that cap itself; its separate ADMIN_ROLE holder can.
controls.evidence: At exact replay-cutoff BSC block 109812367, the USDF token recognized USDFEarn as a MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder. USDFEarn's EIP-1967 implementation was 0x9be60400d043864a99a8fe1be479c9eb299198c1, with zero admin and beacon slots, and USDFMaxSupply() was 500,000,000 USDF. The exact-match implementation source mints only after receiving USDT and enforces that cap. A complete post-cutoff log scan through block 109868579 found no Upgraded, role-change, or cap-change event, so the current authority state projects back to the cutoff.

controls.label: USDF token admin and USDFEarn UUPS upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At exact replay-cutoff BSC block 109812367 (hash 0x958afa5b82a24f0ee89387646d589882bf448dbb5fac8dce521b4911ae834202), USDFEarn's immutable TIMELOCK_ADDRESS resolved to this contract, whose getMinDelay() was 21,600 seconds and whose custom MAX_DELAY was 172,800 seconds. The timelock remained USDF's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder; the token's MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE is administered by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Timelock roles were self-admin plus Safe 0xa8c0c6ee62f5ad95730fe23ccf37d1c1ffaa1c3f as the sole external proposer, executor, and canceller. USDFEarn's exact-match implementation restricts _authorizeUpgrade to this immutable timelock. These are native token-admin, cap, role, and mint-logic controls; the token's separate LayerZero setPeer surface is assessed under Bridge Risk. No upgrade, role, or delay change appeared in the complete post-cutoff scan through block 109868579.

controls.label: Astherus governance multisig (Timelock PROPOSER, 4/7 Safe)
controls.capDescription: This Safe directly holds USDFEarn's ADMIN_ROLE and can change the 500 million USDF maximum supply without the timelock. It separately governs delayed token-role and implementation changes through the timelock.
controls.evidence: At BSC block 116356251, this Safe had 7 owners and threshold 4, with no enabled modules, zero guard and module-guard storage, and the standard Safe Compatibility Fallback Handler 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. It was the timelock's external proposer, executor, and canceller and the sole USDFEarn ADMIN_ROLE member, so its direct cap authority remains a native Mint Authority control. The current Safe topology is retained here; its separate LayerZero EndpointV2 delegate capability is assessed under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: Canonical issuance review at BSC block 116356251 (2026-08-16T22:57:18Z): USDF remained a non-proxy token with USDFEarn 0xc271fc70... recognized as a MINTER_AND_BURN_ROLE holder and timelock 0xe829a87f... recognized as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. USDFEarn was a UUPS proxy with implementation 0x9be60400..., zero admin/beacon slots, immutable upgrade authority equal to that timelock, and a 500 million USDFMaxSupply cap directly administered by Safe 0xa8c0c6ee.... The timelock delay was 21,600 seconds; its external proposer, executor, and canceller was the current 4-of-7 Safe, whose reads showed no enabled modules, zero guard/module-guard storage, and the standard Safe Compatibility Fallback Handler. The Safe can raise the cap directly, and no whole-supply recurring attestation, live reserve feed, prudential supervisor, or independent attestor is evidenced. The USDF token's co-located LayerZero OFT burn/mint and peer/delegate controls are assessed separately under Bridge Risk; the current checked mainnet peers and transfer-limit configurations were zero, so no representation route is treated as active. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: Aster's USDF product and custody materials, Ceffu MirrorX materials, and targeted attestation searches still disclose no recurring independent report or live feed reconciling the complete USDF liability across its strategy reserves. 2026-08-15 reconciliation research: Aster's official USDF product and custody materials describe 1:1 USDT minting, Ceffu/MirrorX custody, delta-neutral positions, and weekly profit distribution to asUSDF, but publish no dated recurring report or named examiner reconciling complete USDF liabilities against reserve/custody assets, and no prudential supervisor is identified.
